name: orbit
description: ORBIT — intelligent knowledge and document platform

scripts.setup: npm run backend:install && npm run web:install
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio && docker compose up --exit-code-from minio-init minio-init
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run infra:up
scripts.infra:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U orbit -d orbit
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose --profile app logs -f api worker scheduler web
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn orbit.composition.asgi:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run celery --app orbit.composition.worker:celery_app worker --pool=solo --loglevel=INFO
scripts.dev:beat: cd backend && uv run celery --app orbit.composition.worker:celery_app beat --loglevel=INFO --schedule=.celerybeat-schedule
scripts.worker:recover: cd backend && uv run python -m orbit.composition.worker recover
scripts.worker:index-status: cd backend && uv run python -m orbit.composition.worker index-status
scripts.worker:reindex: cd backend && uv run python -m orbit.composition.worker reindex-embeddings
scripts.bench:vector: cd backend && uv run python -m benchmarks.vector_search
scripts.eval:retrieval: cd backend && uv run python -m benchmarks.retrieval_eval
scripts.backend:format: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.backend:format:check: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.backend:lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.backend:lint:check: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && uv run pytest -m "not integration and not e2e"
scripts.backend:test:coverage: cd backend && uv run pytest -m "not integration and not e2e" --cov --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html:.coverage-html
scripts.backend:test:integration: cd backend && uv run pytest -m integration
scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:migration: cd backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.e2e:install: cd e2e && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run install:browsers
scripts.verify:backend: npm run backend:format:check && npm run backend:lint:check && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run backend:arch && npm run backend:test
scripts.verify:web: npm run web:format:check && npm run web:lint && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run web:build
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:contract && npm run verify:web
scripts.fix: npm run backend:format && npm run backend:lint && npm run web:format
